title: TeamPlan
description: Per-feature ownership + recommended role mix authored by the architecture agent. project_shape and ownership together let any feature override the global default in policies/agents.config.json#default_ownership.

primary_stack.description: Free-text list of the languages, frameworks, datastores, and runtime targets picked for this feature.

project_shape.description: Optional. Name of a preset under policies/project-shapes/<name>.json whose ownership map is used as the base. Per-feature `ownership` below (if present) overrides individual roles.

ownership.description: Optional. Per-role path globs that override the resolved shape preset (or the global default if no shape is set) FOR THIS FEATURE ONLY. Keys are role names; values are arrays of path globs.
